name: HospitalFlow

tables.definition: MIMIC-IV-compatible patient demographics and anchor metadata (synthetic).

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Identifier of the patient represented by this row.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: gender
columns.definition: Synthetic demographic category recorded for the patient.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: anchor_age
columns.definition: Age in synthetic anchor_year; not an event.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: anchor_year
columns.definition: Synthetic de-identified reference year.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: anchor_year_group
columns.definition: Approximate original-year group (synthetic).
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: dod
columns.definition: Date of death if known; not an assumed process event.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

tables.definition: Synthetic hospital stay using original MIMIC-IV admissions time-column names.
tables.row_grain: One row per hospital admission, identified by hadm_id.

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this particular hospital admission, distinct from the patient identifier.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Patient to whom this hospital admission belongs.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: edregtime
columns.definition: Time of emergency department registration associated with this admission.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: admittime
columns.definition: Time when the patient was admitted for this hospital stay.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: dischtime
columns.definition: Time when the patient actually left this hospital stay.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: deathtime
columns.definition: Actual death timestamp if observed during this admission; NULL in current synthetic cohort.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: edouttime
columns.definition: Time the patient departed the emergency department, as in MIMIC-IV.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: admission_type
columns.definition: Type of admission; administrative attribute, not event.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: admit_provider_id
columns.definition: Admission provider reference.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: admission_location
columns.definition: Location from which admission occurred.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: discharge_location
columns.definition: Discharge destination.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: insurance
columns.definition: Recorded payor category.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: language
columns.definition: Admission-level language preference, not a patient master attribute.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: marital_status
columns.definition: Marital status at admission.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: race
columns.definition: Recorded demographic classification at admission.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: hospital_expire_flag
columns.definition: Whether death occurred during admission (all zero in synthetic sample).
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

tables.definition: Recorded signed discharge summaries associated with hospital admissions.
tables.row_grain: One recorded signed discharge summary per admission represented in this table. Draft documents are outside this table.

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Identifier of the same hospital stay represented in admissions.hadm_id.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: discharge_summary_signed_at
columns.definition: Time when the discharge summary for this admission was signed; signing may occur after the patient has left the hospital.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: Laboratory request; multiple measurements can fulfill it. subject_id identifies the patient even when hadm_id is NULL for a request outside an admission.
tables.row_grain: One authored laboratory request for one patient, optionally associated with an admission.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this laboratory request in the laboratory-order identifier namespace.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Patient for this laboratory request, including requests not associated with a hospital admission.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Optional hospital admission associated with this laboratory request.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: specimen_received_at
columns.definition: Time when specimens associated with this laboratory request were received by the laboratory.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: results_verified_at
columns.definition: Time when the recorded results for this laboratory order were verified.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: One medication prescription, including its stop time. Dispensing is recorded separately in pharmacy.
tables.row_grain: One medication prescription; dispensing records and dose records have their own identities.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this medication request in the medication-order identifier namespace.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Hospital admission under which this medication request was made.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: medication
columns.definition: Generic medication name for synthetic records; not a treatment recommendation.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: stopped_at
columns.definition: Time when medication under this request was stopped.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: Distinct procedure order; repeated execution episodes belong to one order.
tables.row_grain: One row per procedure order; multiple execution episodes may belong to it.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this procedure request in the procedure-order identifier namespace.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Hospital admission under which this procedure request was made.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: procedure_name
columns.definition: Fictional procedure label associated with this synthetic procedure request.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: preparation_completed_at
columns.definition: Time when preparation for this procedure request was completed.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: Recorded actions on laboratory, medication or procedure requests, including repeated reviews.
tables.row_grain: One row per order-action occurrence, including repeated reviews.

columns.name: history_id
columns.definition: Identifier of one order-action occurrence; separate reviews of an order have separate identifiers.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: lab_order_id
columns.definition: Laboratory order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a laboratory request.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: medication_order_id
columns.definition: Medication order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a medication request.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: procedure_order_id
columns.definition: Procedure order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a procedure request.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: action
columns.definition: Physical business-action code in order_history; E = Entered; R = Reviewed; C = Cancelled. Recorded occurrence time is given by the corresponding event timestamp; the code alone is not proof of occurrence.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.definition: Time when this particular order action occurred.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: Laboratory measurement results with specimen collection and result-availability times. charttime denotes specimen collection, not measurement execution.
tables.row_grain: One laboratory measurement result associated with a collected specimen and a laboratory request; collection and result availability have separate timestamps.

columns.name: labevent_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this individual laboratory measurement occurrence.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Laboratory order to which this measurement belongs.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: itemid
columns.definition: Authored laboratory concept: 1001 Creatinine (mg/dL), 1002 Sodium (mmol/L), 1003 Hemoglobin (g/dL). Not original MIMIC codes.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Time when the specimen used for this laboratory measurement was collected. This column does not store measurement execution time.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html#charttime
HospitalFlow records specimen collection in charttime; measurement execution is not represented.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: Time when this laboratory result became available in the laboratory system.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: valuenum
columns.definition: Numeric result recorded for this laboratory measurement.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic
columns.unit: As specified by valueuom for the corresponding test.

columns.name: valueuom
columns.definition: Measurement unit; mg/dL for Creatinine, mmol/L for Sodium, g/dL for Hemoglobin.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

tables.definition: Medication administration or omission records associated with pharmacy dispensing records.
tables.row_grain: One administration or omission record referring to one pharmacy dispensing record.

columns.name: emar_id
columns.definition: Local integer identifier of this administration or omission record; it is not the original MIMIC formatted eMAR identifier.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: pharmacy_id
columns.definition: Dispensing record associated with this administration or omission.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Time when the administration or omission documented by this dose record occurred.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/emar.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: event_txt
columns.definition: Recorded disposition of this medication dose, indicating administration or omission.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/emar.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: Time when the dose record was documented in the medication system.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/emar.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

tables.definition: Hospital-level procedure execution episodes; the ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded.
tables.row_grain: One hospital-level procedure execution episode, not an ICU stay.

columns.name: procedureevent_id
columns.definition: Local synthetic identifier of one procedure execution episode; repeat episodes have separate identifiers.
source_references: Hospital-level adaptation of episode timing; the MIMIC ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded. This is not the original procedureevents schema.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Procedure order executed in this episode.
source_references: Hospital-level adaptation of episode timing; the MIMIC ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded. This is not the original procedureevents schema.

columns.name: starttime
columns.definition: Time when this procedure execution episode began.
source_references: Hospital-level adaptation of episode timing; the MIMIC ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded. This is not the original procedureevents schema.

columns.name: endtime
columns.definition: Time when this procedure execution episode ended.
source_references: Hospital-level adaptation of episode timing; the MIMIC ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded. This is not the original procedureevents schema.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: Time when this episode was recorded in the procedure system.
source_references: Hospital-level adaptation of episode timing; the MIMIC ICU stay_id hierarchy is excluded. This is not the original procedureevents schema.

tables.definition: One distinct dispensing record for a medication prescription; repeated dispensing records can fulfill the same prescription.
tables.row_grain: One dispensing record for one medication prescription; a prescription may have zero or multiple dispensing records.

columns.name: pharmacy_id
columns.definition: Identifier of a single pharmacy dispensing record, distinct from prescription and administration identifiers.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Medication prescription fulfilled by this dispensing record.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: dispensed_at
columns.definition: Time of the individual dispensing represented by this pharmacy record. This is not the first dispensing time for the prescription; each additional dispensing has its own pharmacy_id and row.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

tables.definition: One patient physical-location interval per record, following the MIMIC-IV transfers table shape.
tables.row_grain: One admission, ward transfer, or discharge location interval.

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Patient whose physical-location history this record describes.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Hospital admission associated with this location interval.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: transfer_id
columns.definition: Unique location record identifier.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: eventtype
columns.definition: ed, admit, transfer or discharge interval type. Only transfer is a distinct transfer activity.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: careunit
columns.definition: Care unit occupied during this location interval.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: intime
columns.definition: Actual entry time into the recorded care unit.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: outtime
columns.definition: Actual departure time from the recorded care unit.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

note: Standardized metadata projection. Original input/data_dictionary.json remains authoritative for additional fields; no evaluator Gold included.
